title: Integrated Single-cell and Bulk Transcriptomic Analysis Links NOTCH Signaling to Stromal Features and Prognosis in Gastric Cancer.
snippet: NOTCH signaling is frequently dysregulated in Gastric Cancer (GC) and has been implicated in stromal and immune regulation. This study aimed to characterize NOTCH-associated intercellular communication and develop a transcriptome-based risk model for survival stratification and exploratory prediction of treatment response.
